note: Numpad notation, facing right: 6 = forward, 4 = back, 2 = down, 8 = up, 236 = quarter circle forward. Craft Gauge: 4 bars (400%), kept between rounds. You build it by landing hits (more) and by being hit or blocking (less); whiffs give nothing, and a move that spends meter gives its user none. After spending meter, gains are cut to a quarter for 3 seconds. Below 35% health it slowly fills by itself. Burst gauge: starts full, kept between rounds, refills over time (faster at low health) and when you're hit.

sections.title: Normals
moves: chains A > B > C; 5C reaches with a burst of light
low hits; 2C is a sliding punch that knocks down
overhead (block standing): slow, -4 on block; cancels into specials only on hit
Victory Pump: launches; any normal cancels into it; jump (8) on hit to chase (no jump cancel on block)

moves: arm twirl that absorbs one hit, then a punch that pops them up just in front of her (keep the combo going). Hold B (or C) through the twirl: she dashes through them instead and punches them from behind (side swap, crosses up)
invincible punch with a big light: knocks them all the way to the edge of the screen, and they bounce off it back toward her (juggle). Without 1 bar = 236 + B
uppercut that carries them up with her, above her fist (B: higher, invincible start). Once per jump in the air
A / B / C at Rising Star's top
beam down at an angle that slams them to the floor (from Rising Star's burst)
623 + C (1 bar, also in the air)
invincible; on hit she holds the pose 1.5 s (screen shakes), then spins high into the sky with them on her fist, many hits, launching them at the top
rising knee, then a falling punch (hit high: block standing) into a ground impact (B: higher)
invincible start, higher knee; the impact is a big pillar of light that launches them high (juggle after it)
fills all 3 stars; a flash of light hits around her and she has super armor for a moment
a special's input during a special (1 star)
spend a star to cancel a special into a different special (stars are shown under the Burst gauge)

sections.title: System
moves: needs a FULL Burst gauge and uses all of it; works in hitstun (not out of every special / EX / super hit). Does no damage, knocks them away
A + B + C (or A + C outside hitstun)
full Burst gauge. Flan: 236 always wall bounces, 214 A/B always ground bounces, 623 series can be jump-cancelled
On the ground: dash forward, or back dash with back held. In the air: air dash forward, or back with back held
hold A / B / C (air) or any button (ground)
knocked into the air: holding a button techs as soon as you can (hold forward to tech forward). Knocked down: any button
